title.narrative: Support for Multi-Service Centres for Inclusion and Development in Mexico

description.narrative: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Mexico plans to develop Multi-Service Centres for Inclusion and Development that provide comprehensive care in a single space to people in the context of mobility, with a humane and human rights approach. The project seeks to strengthen and expand capacities in terms of specialised infrastructure for migrants and refugees called Multi-Service Centres for Inclusion and Development, their equipment and services that allow for better humanitarian management of human mobility, as well as to meet the immediate needs of migrants and refugees but also host communities in social matters, with a particular emphasis on labour inclusion, protection and rights, health, with a gender, age, diversity and inclusion perspective.
